items.originalTitle: Why Mercedes thought Max Verstappen was "on some sort of massive bungee cord" in Azerbaijan GP
items.summaryEn: Data analysis showed that whenever George Russell built a gap through the tight middle sector, Max Verstappen closed in rapidly on the straights, leading Mercedes to describe him as being attached by a massive bungee cord.
detailZh: 为什么梅赛德斯认为马克斯·维斯塔潘在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上像“被某种巨大的弹力绳拴住”
数据解析显示，每当乔治·拉塞尔在狭窄的中段拉开差距，马克斯·维斯塔潘就会在直道上追近
马克斯·维斯塔潘（红牛车队）、乔治·拉塞尔（梅赛德斯）
在阿塞拜疆大奖赛的上半程，由于维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈贾尔驾驶的红牛难以超越奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的迈凯伦，拉塞尔得以将对身后车群的领先优势扩大到10秒以上。
当第31圈亚历克斯·阿尔本（阿尔本）的威廉姆斯赛车在5号弯撞上护墙卡住后，安全车出动，局面骤然改变。拉塞尔的优势随着安全车把车流聚拢而化为乌有，而维斯塔潘则在重启时抓住机会超越了皮亚斯特里。
从那时起，尽管拉塞尔在大部分收尾圈里保持着略微更快的速度，但他始终无法甩开维斯塔潘。最后一圈瓦尔特利·博塔斯在15号弯冲出赛道，拉塞尔减速遵守事故现场的黄旗时，他的涡轮失去了增压，这使得维斯塔潘再次咬住他的车尾，并在冲线前上演了一次惊险的猛扑。
令人惊讶的是，在大多数圈次中，拉塞尔在第二计时段都比维斯塔潘快得多——该计时段从5号弯的刹车区开始，环绕旧城墙的紧凑路段，一直延伸到16号弯的刹车区。但维斯塔潘都能在直道上立刻追回来，即使他在前一圈并未足够接近，因而无法获得超车模式所提供的额外半兆焦电能回收与释放。
梅赛德斯一级方程式车队副领队布拉德利·洛德（Bradley Lord）生动地描述了这一幕，他说：“就好像马克斯被一根巨大的弹力绳拴在后面一样。”
马克斯·维斯塔潘（维斯塔潘），红牛车队；乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯车队。
冲线时拉塞尔仅落后维斯塔潘0.196秒，这使它成为世界锦标赛历史上最接近的完赛成绩之一——不过这一数据受影响，因为直到近几十年计时系统才变得精确，之前相对粗糙。
“在最后一圈，你可以把电池的电量从满用到空，这样就不必为了下一圈而让电池包保持平衡，”洛德（Lord）说。
“所以把它揣在兜里备用是好事，因为在那段双重黄旗区域，差距已经从一秒半缩小到半秒。拉塞尔的增压输出也稍微下降了一些，这种情况有时会在车速降得太低、发动机转速也随之下降时发生。”
“但事实并非如此，就好像维斯塔普被一根巨大的蹦极绳拴住了一样。拉塞尔每圈在中段都能实实在在地比他快半秒。而你看GPS数据轨迹，当尾流把维斯塔普重新拉回来时，那条线几乎瞬间变成了垂直状。
“所以如果要说什么的话，他（维斯塔普）在没有使用超车模式时反而似乎比使用时获得的优势更多，这相当反直觉。不过尽管在电视画面上看起来非常接近——当然镜头在一定程度上压缩了距离——但从未有过任何一刻他接近到可以尝试进攻或考虑完成一次超车。
“所以我认为拉塞尔完全掌控了局面，尽管只要出现一个微小的失误，结果可能就会大不相同。他完成了一场绝对精彩的比赛。他说（比赛早些时候）自己蹭到了墙，但实际上这么做反而让他赢得了时间。显然，他连这一点都判断得恰到好处。”
从第39圈安全车时段结束起，维斯塔普仅在第42、43、44和48圈比拉塞尔更快——其中第48圈只快了三毫秒。就整圈用时而言，两人之间的差距很少超过0.1秒，不过在倒数第二圈，拉塞尔快了0.183秒。
阿尔本的撞车改变了比赛的走向。
以第48圈为例，遥测数据显示，维斯塔潘在起步阶段实际上比拉塞尔快约0.1秒，原因是在2号弯到3号弯之间的直道上短暂地快了17公里/小时——这很可能是使用了更多电力输出的结果。但拉塞尔能够更晚松开油门，把梅赛德斯的操控优势转化为3号弯和4号弯更快的弯心速度，立刻逆转了差距。
在第二计时段，拉塞尔在弯道较多的路段将优势扩大到最高0.420秒：5号弯进弯更晚松油门，带来更高的弯心速度，然后在驶向7号弯的路段达到更高的峰值速度，尽管维斯塔潘使用了一些电力增强来获得6号弯更快的出弯。而当维斯塔潘在13号弯到14号弯之间的路段凭借更高的尾速追近时，梅赛德斯底盘更易驾驭的特质再次在15号弯发挥了作用，拉塞尔在那里能更晚松油门，把差距重新拉大到0.583秒。
维斯塔潘获得了更快的出弯，一点点蚕食差距，但梅赛德斯在16号弯再次更快，把差距缩小到0.541秒。从那以后，当他们通过侦测点、解锁下一圈的超车模式时，维斯塔潘迅速吞噬了差距，比拉塞尔更早换入最高挡位——是在18号弯之前而不是19号弯之后——并在该圈余下的路段取得了略高的尾速。
一旦进入直道本身，维斯塔潘一路到终点线都比对手快约11公里/小时，因此尽管他在单圈早段损失了半秒，总时间却只慢了0.003秒。红牛的内燃机是围场中最强大的，这也是它位居国际汽联额外开发与升级机会（ADUO）框架首位的原因，但作为整体套件，梅赛德斯的动力单元仍被认为更为出色。
尽管如此，虽然维斯塔潘和红牛车队领队洛朗·梅基斯都不愿透露得到福特支持的动力单元究竟发挥了多大作用，但使用同一套动力单元的小红牛车手阿维德·林德布拉德形容它为“一枚火箭”。
考虑到维斯塔潘在跟在拉塞尔尾流中时，在两个直线模式区域都享有如此大的速度优势，红牛赛车在主动空气动力学部署时很可能特别低阻——其他车队无疑会对此进行深入研究，抱以极大兴趣。
detailEn: Why Mercedes thought Max Verstappen was "on some sort of massive bungee cord" in Azerbaijan GP
Data analysis shows that every time George Russell pulled out a gap through the tight middle sector, Max Verstappen closed in on the straight
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes

For the first half of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, George Russell was able to build a gap beyond 10 seconds to the chasing pack, as the Red Bulls of Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar struggled to pass Oscar Piastri's McLaren.

That picture altered abruptly when the safety car was deployed after Alex Albon's Williams became embedded in the wall at Turn 5 on lap 31. Russell's margin vanished as the safety car bunched up the field, and Verstappen seized the moment to pass Piastri at the restart.

From there, while Russell maintained marginally quicker for the majority of the closing laps, he was never able to shake Verstappen off. When Valtteri Bottas went off at Turn 15 on the final lap, Russell's turbo went off boost as he slowed to obey the yellow flags at the scene, enabling Verstappen to latch onto his tail again and set up a dramatic lunge to the tape.

What's remarkable is that on most laps, Russell was substantially faster than Verstappen through the second sector, which extends from the Turn 5 braking zone, around the tight section circumnavigating the old city walls, through to the Turn 16 braking zone. But Verstappen was able to come right back at him on the straight, even if he hadn't been close enough on the previous lap to access the extra half-megajoule of electrical harvesting and deployment granted by overtake mode.
Mercedes deputy Formula 1 team principal Bradley Lord described it in vivid terms, saying "it was like Max was on some sort of massive bungee cord".
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes

Just 0.196s separated Russell from Verstappen at the line, making this one of the closest finishes in world championship history – although that statistic is skewed by the relative crudeness of the timing systems until recent decades.
"On the last lap you can drain the battery from top to bottom so you don't have to keep the [battery] pack balanced for the following lap," said Lord.

"And so it was good we had that in the pocket because the gap had gone from a second and a half to half a second through that double yellow. George dropped off the boost slightly as well, which sometimes can happen when the car speed drops too low and the engine speed does as well.

"But no, it was like Max was on some sort of massive bungee cord. George would literally put half a second on him every lap through the middle sector. And you look at the GPS trace and suddenly it almost goes vertical as the tow pulls Max back in.

"So if anything it almost seemed he [Verstappen] was gaining more without overtake mode than with, which was quite counterintuitive. But even though it looked very close on the TV pictures and obviously they foreshortened things a little bit, there wasn't any point where he was close enough to make an attempt or to contemplate an overtake.

"So I think George had it all under control, albeit one tiny mistake and it could have looked pretty different. Just an absolutely fantastic job from him. He said he'd brushed the wall, [earlier in the race] but he actually gained time doing it. So clearly he judged even that perfectly."

From the end of the safety car period on lap 39, Verstappen was only quicker than Russell on laps 42, 43, 44 and 48 – the latter by three milliseconds. In terms of overall laptime they were rarely separated by more than a tenth, although Russell was 0.183s quicker on the penultimate lap.
Albon's shunt changed the direction of the race

Taking lap 48 as an example, the telemetry data indicates Verstappen was actually around a tenth of a second up on Russell early on, by dint of briefly being 17km/h faster on the stretch between Turns 2 and 3 – likely a factor of using more electrical deployment. But Russell was able to get off the throttle later and parlay the Mercedes' handling advantage into faster apex speeds at Turn 3 and 4, immediately inverting the deficit.

Through the second sector, Russell built his advantage to a peak of 0.420s through the twistier sections: later off the throttle into Turn 5, giving a higher apex speed, then hitting a higher peak speed on the run to Turn 7 even though Verstappen used some boost to gain a faster initial exit from Turn 6. And while Verstappen came back at him through the stretch between Turns 13 and 14, with a higher top speed, again the Mercedes' more biddable chassis made the difference at Turn 15, where Russell was able to dethrottle much later and pull the gap back to 0.583s.

Verstappen got a quicker exit, nibbling away at the gap, but again the Merc was quicker through Turn 16, taking the gap to 0.541s. From there onwards, as they passed the detection point unlocking overtake mode for the following lap. Verstappen simply ate up the gap, changing to top gear much earlier than Russell – before Turn 18 rather than after Turn 19 – and attaining a slightly higher top speed for the remainder of the lap.

Once on the straight itself, Verstappen was around 11km/h faster all the way to the line, hence his total time being just 0.003s slower despite losing half a second earlier in the lap. The Red Bull internal combustion engine is the most powerful on the grid, hence its position atop the FIA's Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities (ADUO) framework, but as a package the Mercedes PU is still believed to be superior.

Still, while Verstappen and Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies would not be drawn on how significant a role the Ford-backed PU made, Arvid Lindblad, whose VCARB uses the same unit, described it as "a rocketship".

Given how much of a speed advantage Verstappen enjoyed in both straightline mode zones when in Russell's tow, it's likely the Red Bull is particularly slippery when its active aerodynamics are deployed – something other teams will no doubt be examining with great interest.

items.originalTitle: George Russell Baku F1 win sparks "cracked the code" theory
items.summaryEn: Former IndyCar Series driver and F1 TV pundit James Hinchcliffe believes George Russell may have unlocked the performance of his Mercedes machinery, questioning whether the Briton has "cracked the code" to gain an edge over his team-mate Kimi Antonelli.
detailZh: 拉塞尔巴库F1夺冠引发"破解密码"论
詹姆斯·欣奇克利夫质疑拉塞尔是否已在梅赛德斯"破解了密码"
前印地赛车系列赛车手、F1电视评论员詹姆斯·欣奇克利夫认为，拉塞尔可能已经完全释放了梅赛德斯赛车的性能，质疑这位英国车手是否"破解了密码"，从而相对队友基米·安东内利取得优势。
拉塞尔统治了阿塞拜疆大奖赛整个周末，在巴库城市赛道夺得杆位并赢下正赛。目前在车手积分榜上领先的安东内利在排位赛中发生撞车。
安东内利从发车位的第16位起步，最终获得第五名，拿到10个积分，而拉塞尔拿到了25分。因此，拉塞尔将这位意大利车手的积分榜优势缩小到66分。
欣克利夫在F1 Nation播客节目中谈到了拉塞尔的表现。
“对我来说有意思的是，即使在其他赛道上，当乔治在练习中做出好的单圈、有出色的排位表现时，在正赛中基米始终还是占据上风，哪怕乔治赢下比赛的时候也是如此，”欣克利夫解释道。
“回想一下巴塞罗那，他在基米的赛车报废之前完成了对基米的超越。在奥地利他也在不断追赶前面所有人。而今天情况不一样了。基米没有乔治那样的速度。整个周末基米都没有乔治那样的速度。”
"好吧，他确实在第一节练习赛缺席了几圈，但他有第二节练习赛，也有第三节练习赛。他是职业车手，能很快进入状态。我真正好奇的是，拉塞尔是不是已经破解了密码？他是不是找到了什么？他是不是弄明白了如何从这辆车上多榨出那一点点性能？因为整个周末，安东内利任何时候都没能接近他的水平。"
欣克利夫补充道："我不是说他已经做到了，但我很好奇，等到了马来西亚、到了新加坡，我们会不会看到他更接近一些，尤其是在比赛节奏方面，也许他终于开始把所有拼图拼到一起了。"
detailEn: George Russell Baku F1 win sparks "cracked the code" theory
James Hinchcliffe has questioned whether George Russell has "cracked the code" at Mercedes

Former IndyCar Series driver and F1 TV pundit James Hinchcliffe believes George Russell may have unlocked the performance of his Mercedes machinery, questioning whether the Briton has "cracked the code" to gain an edge over his team-mate Kimi Antonelli.
Russell dominated the Azerbaijan Grand Prix weekend, taking pole position and winning the race at the Baku City Circuit. Antonelli, who leads the drivers' championship, crashed during qualifying.
After starting from 16th on the grid, Antonelli finished fifth, collecting 10 points compared to Russell's 25. As a result, Russell reduced the Italian's championship advantage to 66 points.
Speaking on the F1 Nation podcast, Hinchcliffe discussed Russell's performance.

"What's interesting for me is even at other tracks when George has been able to pull out good laps in practice, a good qualifying effort, in the race Kimi's always still had the edge, even when George has won," Hinchcliffe explained.

"You think back to when he passed him in Barcelona before Kimi's car expired. He was closing down on everybody in Austria. Today they didn't have that. Kimi did not have the pace of George. Kimi didn't have the pace of George all weekend long.

"Fine, he missed some laps in first practice, but he had FP2. He had FP3. He's a professional. He gets up to speed quickly. What I'm really curious about is, has George cracked the code a little bit? Has he found something? Has he figured out how to get that extra step of performance out of this car? Because at no point this weekend was Kimi anywhere close to his level."

Hinchcliffe added: "And I'm not saying that he has, but I'm curious if we get to Malaysia, if we get to Singapore, if we start seeing him closer, especially in race pace, maybe he has finally started to put all the pieces together."

items.titleZh: 博塔斯为何在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上比佩雷兹慢那么多？
items.summaryZh: 2026赛季F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛上，凯迪拉克车队两名车手佩雷兹与博塔斯之间的队内差距异常悬殊，排位赛博塔斯慢了1.632秒，正赛中每圈落后约1.9秒。

items.originalTitle: How was Valtteri Bottas so much slower than Sergio Perez in the Azerbaijan GP?
items.summaryEn: In the 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix, there was a stark intra-team gap at Cadillac between Sergio Perez and Valtteri Bottas, with Bottas outqualified by 1.632s and losing roughly 1.9s per lap in the race.
detailZh: 博塔斯为何在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上比佩雷兹慢那么多？
巴库的两位凯迪拉克车手之间存在显著的节奏差异——这是他们尽己所知对此的解释
截至目前，在2026赛季F1中，可能还没有哪场比赛的队内表现差距像阿塞拜疆大奖赛上佩雷兹与博塔斯之间的差距如此悬殊。
周五的排位赛中，博塔斯虽受黄旗影响，但仍落后1.632秒，而他的困境一直延续到正赛深处。到第26圈第一次进站时，这位芬兰车手已经落后队友的凯迪拉克超过46秒，相当于每圈损失1.9秒。他比赛后段的节奏也类似，安全车出动之后，他每圈仍被拉开约1.6秒。
“挺漫长的一场比赛，”当被要求描述自己的比赛时，博塔斯紧张地轻笑着说。“说实话，完全没有速度。我只能和费尔南多（阿隆索）斗一斗——当然，我们在那里损失了一些时间。除此之外，差距相当大，所以这个周末有很多东西需要研究。”
这位老将确实不得不采取一些省油滑行的驾驶方式，但他认为这并不能解释他巨大的差距。“我觉得还有别的原因。我们会去查一查，”他说。
与此同时，佩雷斯在第一段比赛中始终跟得上中游车队的节奏。第20圈，当塞恩斯第一次进站时，这位西班牙车手仅领先凯迪拉克一秒；奥迪车队的霍肯伯格和博尔托莱托也没有落后太远。
佩雷斯充分利用了安全车时机，回到赛道时排到了塞恩斯前面，并在重启后的混乱中短暂超越博尔托莱托，一度名列第12位，但最终又跌回到第15位，排在劳森、博尔托莱托和皮亚斯特里身后。
“说实话，这是我在巴库最好的周末之一，我把那辆车的性能发挥到了150%，”这位两届阿塞拜疆大奖赛冠军说道。
“我们一直在和那些因为超车模式而比我们快一到两秒的赛车较量，所以第一段（ stint ）我们始终跟住了他们——和威廉姆斯的车、和奥迪的车，差距很大。但最后在重新发车时，我们就是没有直道速度，所以掉了下去。我们和皮亚斯特里争了一会儿，我想他当时可能有一些损伤。”
“目前我们缺少大约半秒到一秒的速度，才能和他们混在一起竞争。”
“问题其实就是我的速度。我在直道上就像一个活靶子，所以我知道机会不多。”
因此，佩雷兹与博塔斯之间的差距可以用这位墨西哥车手在巴库街道上的进攻性风格来解释：“按照我当时开车的感觉，任何一个弯角只要出一点差错，我都会撞上护墙。所以当你跑完这样一场比赛时，你会感到非常自豪。”
与此同时，博塔斯的比赛在方格旗挥出前不久因技术故障以撞墙告终。
“就在我同一圈，我在1号弯锁死了轮胎，冲出了赛道，”这位凯迪拉克车手解释道。“然后我想是因为多跑了距离，系统有点混乱了。我在15号弯发生了严重打滑，之后当我踩刹车时，只有前刹车起作用，几乎就像后轮不再回收能量了一样。所以，那里有些东西出现了一点混乱。”
这位芬兰车手现在已经连续三场大奖赛，在赛道上没有哪怕一个比赛圈跑在队友前面。
detailEn: How was Valtteri Bottas so much slower than Sergio Perez in the Azerbaijan GP?
There was a significant pace difference between the Cadillac drivers in Baku – here’s how they explain it to the best of their knowledge
There may never have been, so far in the 2026 Formula 1 season, such a stark contrast in intra-team performance as between Sergio Perez and Valtteri Bottas in the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

Bottas was outqualified by 1.632s on Friday, albeit hindered by a yellow flag, and his woes persisted deep into the race. By his first pitstop on lap 26, the Finn was already over 46 seconds adrift of the sister Cadillac, equating to a 1.9s loss per lap. His late-race pace was similar, as after the safety car interventions he was dropping back by 1.6s a lap.

“Long one,” Bottas nervously chuckled when asked to describe his race. “Honestly, no pace at all. I could only fight with Fernando [Alonso] – for sure, we lost some time there. Otherwise, pretty far off, so lots of things to look into from this weekend.”
The veteran did have to do some lift-and-coast but reckoned that didn’t explain his mammoth deficit. “I think there's something else. We'll have a look,” he said.

Meanwhile, Perez matched the pace of the midfield throughout the first stint. On lap 20, when Carlos Sainz made his first pitstop, the Spaniard led the Cadillac by just one second; Audi pair Nico Hulkenberg and Gabriel Bortoleto weren’t much further down the road.

Perez made the most of the safety car to emerge back on track ahead of Sainz and passed Gabriel Bortoleto to ever so briefly hold 12th following the restart chaos, but eventually fell back down to 15th behind Liam Lawson, Bortoleto and Oscar Piastri.
“It's been one of my best weekends in Baku to be honest, I managed to get 150% out of that car,” the two-time Azerbaijan GP winner said.

“We were fighting cars that are a second or two seconds faster than us due to the overtake mode, so we stayed with them throughout the first stint – with the Williams, with the Audi, big gap. But then in the end at the restart we just don't have any straightline speed, so we fall back. We fought for a bit with Piastri, I think he had some damage.
“At the moment we're lacking really half a second to a second to be able to mix with them.
“The problem is really my pace. I was a sitting duck on the straights, so I knew that there was not much opportunity.”

The gap between Perez and Bottas may therefore be explained by the Mexican’s attacking ethos in the Baku streets: “The way I felt like I was driving, if anything went wrong at any corner I would have put it in the wall. So when you do a race like this, you feel really proud.”
Meanwhile, Bottas’ race ended in the wall due to a technical issue shortly before the checkered flag.

“The same lap I had a lock-up into Turn 1, I went wide,” the Cadillac driver explained. “Then I think the systems got a bit confused because of the extra distance. I had a huge super clip into Turn 15, and then when I hit the brakes, only the front brakes would work, almost like I wasn't harvesting anymore with the rears. So, something got a bit confused there.”
The Finn has now had three consecutive grands prix without spending a single racing lap ahead of his team-mate on the track.

items.originalTitle: Juan Pablo Montoya admires Franco Colapinto's "aggressive" approach despite Baku crash
items.summaryEn: Former F1 driver Juan Pablo Montoya has defended Franco Colapinto's aggressive approach despite the Argentine triggering a costly multi-car collision at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
detailZh: 胡安·帕布洛·蒙托亚赞赏弗朗哥·科拉平托的激进驾驶风格，尽管发生巴库撞车事故
尽管在阿塞拜疆大奖赛发生代价高昂的多车相撞事故，胡安·帕布洛·蒙托亚仍为弗朗哥·科拉平托的激进驾驶方式辩护
前F1车手胡安·帕布洛·蒙托亚在弗朗哥·科拉平托于阿塞拜疆大奖赛引发代价高昂的多车相撞事故后，仍为其激进驾驶方式辩护。
科拉平托在巴库城市赛道的安全车重启阶段于1号弯引发连环相撞。这位阿根廷车手刹车点判断失误导致车轮锁死，撞上了他的阿尔派队友皮埃尔·加斯利，加斯利随后又撞上了兰多·诺里斯。三名车手全部被迫退赛。
虽然科拉平托在比赛结束后立即道歉，并承认自己“完全失控”，但这起事故还是招致了其他涉事车手的批评。不过，蒙托亚在F1电视的赛后直播节目中谈到了这起撞车，对科拉平托的处理方式提出了不同看法，并给予了称赞。
“我想他预期大家都会刹得很深。问题在于，当你在那么靠后的位置时，就像堵车一样，”这位哥伦比亚车手解释道，“大家不断减速、不断减速。你看他刹车了，眼看就要撞上前面的某个人。”
“所以他选择让开，走到了内侧，而且他几乎把车停住了。他犯了错，撞上了队友，也把兰多撞了出去。他确实犯了一个错误，但情况很惊险。”
弗朗哥·科拉平托，阿尔派；兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦
他补充道：“这方面难的地方在于你要有攻击性；你看到一个机会，我钦佩敢于尝试的人。当比赛重启时，他们会把它看作一个机会。有些人把重启看作‘我不想丢掉位置’，而弗朗哥是那种想冲上去把握机会的人。
“当你总是像马克斯·维斯塔潘那样，总是看到机会就想去把握的人，你就难免会犯错。”
科拉平托目前在车手积分榜上以27分排名第十二。相比之下，加斯利以41分排名第十。
detailEn: Juan Pablo Montoya admires Franco Colapinto's "aggressive" approach despite Baku crash
Juan Pablo Montoya has defended Franco Colapinto's aggressive approach despite his costly multi-car collision at the Azerbaijan GP
Former Formula 1 driver Juan Pablo Montoya has defended Franco Colapinto's "aggressive" approach following a costly multi-car collision at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

Colapinto triggered a Turn 1 pile-up during a safety car restart at the Baku City Circuit. Misjudging his braking point, the Argentinian driver locked up and collided with his Alpine team-mate Pierre Gasly, who in turn crashed into Lando Norris. All three drivers were forced to retire from the grand prix.

While Colapinto apologised immediately after the race and admitted he was "completely out of control", the incident drew criticism from the other drivers involved. But speaking on F1 TV's post-race broadcast, Montoya offered a different view of the crash, praising Colapinto's approach.

"I think he expected everybody to go pretty deep. The problem is when you're so far back it's like a traffic jam," the Colombian explained. "Everybody backs off and backs off. And you see he brakes and he's going to run over somebody.
"So he gets out of the way and gets to the inside, and he nearly stopped the car. He made a mistake and ran over the team-mate and he took Lando out as well. He made a mistake, but it was close."
Franco Colapinto, Alpine, Lando Norris, McLaren

He added: "The hard thing there is you're aggressive; you see an opportunity, and I admire people that try. When you have a restart, they see it as an opportunity. Some people see the restart as, 'I don't want to lose a position,' and Franco is the guy who wants to go and take it.
"When you're always the guy, like Max Verstappen, who always sees an opportunity to take it, you're going to make mistakes."
Colapinto currently sits 12th in the drivers' championship with 27 points. By comparison, Gasly is 10th with 41 points.
keyPointsZh: 事故发生在巴库城市赛道1号弯，当时安全车重启
科拉平托刹车点判断失误锁死车轮，撞上队友加斯利
加斯利随后又撞上诺里斯，三名车手全部退赛
keyPointsEn: The crash occurred at Turn 1 of the Baku City Circuit during a safety car restart
Colapinto misjudged his braking point, locked up and hit his Alpine team-mate Pierre Gasly
Gasly then crashed into Lando Norris, and all three drivers were forced to retire
